lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 106910112 · After Strongest ★ Romantic ☆ Maid ♥ chat 2. Buddy?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Today's the last day we'll be in business at the pirate cafe.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: I already know that

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: I'll look back on my time here fondly.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: Buddy, we've got a big problem.
What it is?

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Yes, I'll never forget the memories I've forged here...

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: Look outside.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: We're not even open yet, and there's already a line.

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: There are more people out there than we'd had on entire days before.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Indeed, the time I've spent here is...
Do we have enough stock?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: We should have enough, but just barely.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: It looks like more people are coming, so we'll need to buy more.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: HEY?!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: What's the big idea with all of you? I'm trying to wax poetic here!
Sorry, but you'll have to save it for the afterparty.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: What are we doing for that, by the way?

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: Let's go somewhere special!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: If special is what you want, then we have to go to the sea!

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Oooh!

lines.speaker: trony_m
lines.text: You all have fun out there.

lines.speaker: sin_m
lines.text: Ha! Hilarious.
Mast, take Trony and go buy more ingredients.

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Got it!

lines.speaker: mast_m
lines.text: Let's see this adventure through to the end!
